remarks:
Usually quaint and cozy equals small, but this 3 bed/2 bath home lives big with plenty of storage.  Sitting on one acre of wooded land, it offers privacy, nature, and tranquility.  
First floor living, if you desire, however the storage, floor plan and large room sizes offer a family a lot of living spaces.  The den off the kitchen has a cozy propane stove for heat and ambiance.  First floor bedroom available or use it as an office or play space.  The large eat in kitchen with plenty of counterspace, multiple work areas and view of the den make it a joy to work in.  Formal dining area overlooks the sunroom with access to the patio and a view to nature.  The large living room allows a good gathering place for entertaining or relaxing with family.
On the second floor, a full bath separates two large bedrooms.  The master bedroom includes a large space of auxiliary use..sitting area, workout area; however you wish to use it.  Abundant storage; every square inch is available on the second floor including attic space over the garage with convenient outside access.
This is a home to make memories in.  Per owner request, negotiations will begin on Monday, October 12 at 5:00 PM.
